## Goal
- Extend IVX autonomous coder from a PATCH engine into a FACTORY engine that can build apps from scratch, install deps, provision Supabase, run builds, create tools, self-upgrade, AND persist factory-created files to GitHub — wire REAL runners, prove end-to-end live, build + ship latest APK; fix senior developer fake-narrative/BLOCKED behavior when user asks to deploy live

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- Owner demands honest senior-developer audit — NOT narrative claims; wants real end-to-end proof; demands fixes be deployed live with proof
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use `node:zlib` `gzipSync`; use `node tmp/commit-*.mjs` scripts (ES modules, `.mjs` extension)
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- APK upload: owner-gated `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}` → returns `uploadUrl` + `publicUrl` → PUT APK to S3 → verify via HEAD on publicUrl; do NOT send `Content-MD5` header
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h; sandbox resets may wipe `/tmp/owner_at` — re-mint when missing)
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Owner-AI POST requires `{"message": "..."}` field (NOT `"prompt"`)
- Dedup: resubmitting same prompt to `/api/ivx/owner-ai` returns existing job — use unique runId in prompt
- `bun test backend/` = 1605 tests / 0 fail (5999 expects); factory tests = 33 pass / 0 fail
- Scoped typecheck: `bun x tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler <files>` (NOT `npx`; NOT `--module nodenext` which causes TS1470); if TS5112 error, use `--ignoreConfig` flag
- Plan_md: `.rork/plans/stop-kotlin-work-expo-app-is-the-only-mo_1784341475573.plan.md`; lines start with `- [x]` or `- [ ]` (NO leading spaces)
- Watchman workaround: `mv /usr/local/bin/watchman /usr/local/bin/watchman.disabled` — proven for sandbox gradle builds
- GITHUB_TOKEN provided by owner via secure requestEnvs box; token is private env — NOT visible in sandbox bash, injected into Render runtime on deploy
- Bash commands must complete under 60s or they timeout — do NOT loop-poll with sleeps; use single checks
- Gradle build exceeds 60s tool timeout — must use `setsid` detached background process + poll log; `setsid sh -c 'cd .../android && ./gradlew assembleRelease ... > /tmp/log 2>&1 < /dev/null' &` (note: gradlew is at `expo/android/gradlew`, NOT `expo/gradlew`)
- Clean sandbox has NO `node_modules` — must run `bun install` in `expo/` before gradle build
- Android resources (mipmap icons, splashscreen_logo) may be missing in clean sandbox — regenerate with ImageMagick `convert` from `assets/images/`

## Progress
### Done
- **FACTORY ENGINE BUILT, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, AND PROVEN LIVE** (prior sessions):
  - `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory.ts` — 7 operation kinds: `create_directory`, `create_module`, `install_dependency`, `run_supabase_migration`, `run_build`, `create_tool`, `upgrade_self`
  - 33 regression tests ALL PASS; 8 base capabilities; tool registry; path guards
  - Prior commits: `e1deca44` + `04f54652` + `8fa36ef0` + `1f628490` + `56a3d061`
  - Prior live proof: job `ivx-worker-2e87f468` COMPLETED (create_tool + upgrade_self)

- **REAL FACTORY RUNNERS MODULE + WORKER WIRING** (prior sessions):
  - `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory-runners.ts` — `realMigrationRunner`, `realDependencyRunner`, `realBuildRunner`, `commitFactoryFilesToGitHub`, `getRealFactoryRunners`
  - Worker wiring in `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: runners injected into `runIVXFactoryJob()`

- **FACTORY COMMIT GAP DIAGNOSED AND CLOSED** (prior session):
  - Fix: `readOwnerRuntimeVariable()` in factory-runners.ts — checks process.env FIRST, then dynamic import of ownerVariablesStore
  - Commit `58866d36`; LIVE PROOF: job `ivx-worker-076f4d88`, COMMIT SHA: `4bee0c04`

- **SUPABASE 503 ROOT CAUSE FIXED + COMMITTED + DEPLOYED + PROVEN LIVE** (this session):
  - Root cause: `REST_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_500` (2.5s) in `backend/api/ivx-supabase-inspection.ts:119` — too short for cold PostgREST → AbortError → misclassified as `relation_missing` → 503
  - Fix: 3 surgical edits in `backend/api/ivx-supabase-inspection.ts` — raised timeout to 12_000; AbortError now throws descriptive "timed out" message → classifier routes to `backend_timeout` (500) not `relation_missing` (503); 5xx returns false in `probeSupabaseRestTable`
  - Committed: `38bcc208354d` ✅
  - **CONFIRMED LIVE**: runtime on `38bcc208` (boot 2026-07-20T03:05:15Z, healthy); 3-way SHA parity GitHub=Render=Runtime ✅
  - **Live proof**: exact probe that aborted before now returns HTTP 200 in 8.89s with honest answer "The table ivx_factory_e2e_proof does not exist" — NO ABORT, NO 503
  - 7/7 health endpoints 200; Supabase health 200, 27ms latency

- **APK v1.4.21(53) BUILT + UPLOADED + VERIFIED LIVE** (this session):
  - Chat send-queue timeout raised 60s → 600s (10 minutes) in `expo/src/modules/chat/services/useChatSendQueue.ts` per owner suggestion
  - Version: v1.4.21, versionCode 53, buildMarker `IVX_BUNDLE_2026_07_20_BUILD_53_CHAT_TIMEOUT_10MIN_SUPABASE_503_FIX`
  - APK: 82,956,771 bytes, md5 `1d692ec3d67079424c10284486f4e854`, sha256 `2f1e4a18fbc6a1f7d30c507e3e9764d05ab7752586f752fd7ffbf5c1707a0377`
  - LIVE at `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.21.apk` (HTTP 200, Content-Length + S3 ETag exact match ✅)
  - 3 files committed to GitHub via owner-gated `github_commit_file` (useChatSendQueue.ts, app.config.ts, build.gradle)

- **SENIOR DEV FAKE-NARRATIVE/BLOCKED FIX — CODE CHANGES APPLIED, TESTS PASS** (this session, NOT yet committed/deployed):
  - Root cause: `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts` — when `changedFiles.length === 0`, skips deploy operator entirely and returns BLOCKED with "No code change was required" even when user asked to "fix and deploy live"
  - **Runtime fix applied** to `ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts`:
    - Added `getGithubBranchHead()` helper (reads branch HEAD SHA from GitHub API without committing)
    - Added `deployOnly` flag to `buildGitDeployOperator()` — when true, skips commit, gets branch HEAD, triggers `triggerRenderDeploy(headSha)` directly
    - Main flow: when `productionProofRequested && !hasRealChange`, runs deploy-only branch instead of BLOCKED
    - Removed `hasRealChange` requirement from `endToEndProductionComplete` — deploy-only counts as complete
    - When no deploy requested and no code change, reason says "COMPLETED with no phantom deploy" (not BLOCKED)
  - **Answer format fix applied** to `ivx-senior-developer-answer-format.ts`:
    - `changedFiles.length === 0` no longer hardcodes `BLOCKED` — now shows `LOCAL ONLY` when no deploy, `DEPLOYED` when deploy-only succeeds
    - `deployConfirmed` checks `git.render.deployAttempted || git.github.commitAttempted` (not just `commitSha`)
    - Added deploy-only proof line: `deploy-only from commit: {sha} ({branch})`
  - **Tests updated** in `ivx-senior-developer-answer-format.test.ts`: 13 pass / 0 fail
  - `ivx-developer-execution-guard.test.ts` + `ivx-ia-reliability-gate.test.ts` also pass

### In Progress
- **Senior dev BLOCKED fix — needs commit + deploy + live verification**: code changes applied to 3 files (`ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts`, `ivx-senior-developer-answer-format.ts`, `ivx-senior-developer-answer-format.test.ts`), tests pass, but NOT yet committed to GitHub or deployed to Render

### Blocked
- (none — all prior blockers resolved; senior dev fix is in progress, not blocked)

## Key Decisions
- APK v1.4.21(53) is the latest shipped version, superseding v1.4.20(52) and v1.4.19(51)
- Supabase 503 fix CONFIRMED LIVE — probe that aborted now returns clean 200 in 8.89s
- Chat timeout raised to 10 minutes (600s) per owner's explicit suggestion — senior-dev and factory tasks can run for minutes
- Senior dev BLOCKED fix: deploy-only branch redeploys latest GitHub HEAD when user asks to deploy but no code change needed; answer format no longer shows BLOCKED for no-code-change cases
- Honest assessment given to owner: system has senior-dev capabilities but delivery was unreliable — being fixed now

## Next Steps
- Commit senior dev fix (3 files) to GitHub via `github_commit_file` with `CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE`
- Deploy to Render via `render_trigger_deploy` with `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY`
- Verify live: re-run the exact prompt "audit this chat why is a lot loading fix end to end and update deploy live" to confirm it no longer returns BLOCKED
- Update plan_md with v1.4.21(53) entry and senior dev fix entry
- No new APK needed — senior dev fix is backend-only (no frontend changes)

## Critical Context
- APK download link: `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.21.apk` (82,956,771 bytes, live verified)
- Runtime currently on commit `38bcc208354d` (Supabase fix), healthy since boot 2026-07-20T03:05:15Z
- `IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_CONFIRM_TEXT = 'CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR'` (line 25 of ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts)
- `productionProofRequested = input.systemMode === true || (input.approveGitDeploy === true && input.gitDeployConfirmationText === IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_CONFIRM_TEXT)`
- Worker job answer format (`buildSeniorDeveloperWorkerJobAnswer`) already handles deploy-only correctly: uses `result.commitSha` + `result.commitMatch` + `result.endToEndProductionComplete` to determine DEPLOYED/UNVERIFIED/LOCAL ONLY
- `summarizeProof` in `ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` captures `commitSha` from `proof.gitDeployOperator.github.commitSha` and `deployId` from `proof.gitDeployOperator.render.deployId`
- Execution mode classifier: 11 categories — `fix`, `build`, `deploy`, `audit`, `qa`, `refactor`, `migration`, `create_module
